goal: Create the minimum Phase 1 repository record surface before any Godot implementation begins.

verify.name: Bootstrap records validate against existing schemas
verify.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/done/WP-2026W22-001.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260527-001.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/review.schema.json -d reviews/RV-20260527-001.json

acceptance_criteria: The repository has work_packages, runs, reviews, game, and scripts surfaces.
The bootstrap Work Package, Run, and Review records validate against their schemas.
No Godot project, build script, smoke-test script, CI, adapter, model router, or web export artifact is created.
notes: Bootstrap exception: this Work Package is created with the record surface it authorizes because the record directories did not exist before Slice 1. AJV validation uses --strict=false because the existing schemas declare date and date-time formats without bundling an AJV format plugin.
